text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and longer connected clauses","quality":"syntactic variety","description":"Uses a wider range of sentence structures rather than repeating the same simple pattern throughout."},{"evidence":"e.g., \"in all honesty,\" \"Similar to,\" \"In my eyes,\" \"The debate about whether or not\"","quality":"discourse control","description":"Uses transitions and framing moves to organize ideas and signal relationships between points."},{"evidence":"\"under qualified,\" \"rose colored glasses,\" \"iron will\"","quality":"vocabulary range","description":"Shows more varied word choice and some more precise or vivid expressions."},{"evidence":"\"would be\", \"do decide\", \"can take you places\"","quality":"sentence fluency","description":"Maintains a more natural flow across sentences even when informal, with fewer disruptive breakdowns."},{"evidence":"extended explanation of attitudes versus decisions","quality":"development of ideas","description":"Expands points with more sustained reasoning instead of mainly listing reasons."}]}
